title: Playboy December 1985 Barbi Benton Bill Cosby Christmas Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Front cover clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. The cream back cover has some small dark specks/spots, mostly near the lower right (see photo 3), and light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, December 1985 - Gala Christmas Issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: Barbi Benton is back. Also: Playboy Interview with Bill Cosby; why drug enforcement can't work; guide to the best dating bars in America; Andrew Tobias on tax shelters; holiday features with David Letterman, Brooke Shields, Huey Lewis, Dan Jenkins, Paul Theroux, Donald Westlake and more.

Back cover: Seagram's 7 Crown holiday ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
